facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A wolf appeared. He looked friendly. He talked to the girl. The wolf spoke.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Red Riding Hood was walking when a big wolf appeared. The wolf had big eyes and pointy ears. But he pretended to be friendly and kind. The wolf spoke to her in a soft, gentle voice. He asked where she was going with her basket. Red Riding Hood told him about Grandmother's house.
facts.Word cards: Red Riding Hood = 빨간 모자 / walked = 걸었다 / forest = 숲 / brave = 용감한
